from view import View


def test_monotonic_ids():
    v = View()
    a = v.begin("q1")
    b = v.begin("q2")
    assert a < b
    assert a == 1 and b == 2


def test_only_latest_can_finish():
    v = View()
    old = v.begin("q1")
    latest = v.begin("q2")
    assert v.finish(old, [1, 2]) is False
    assert v.finish(latest, [3, 4]) is True
    assert v.rows == [3, 4]
    assert v.finish(latest, [5, 6]) is False


def test_finish_before_begin():
    v = View()
    assert v.finish(1, [1]) is False


def test_begin_clears_error_and_loading():
    v = View()
    v.error = "boom"
    v.begin("q")
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.loading is True


def test_rows_kept_until_valid_finish():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.rows = [9, 9]
    assert v.finish(1, [1, 2]) is False
    assert v.rows == [9, 9]
    assert v.finish(1, [1, 2]) is True
    assert v.rows == [1, 2]


def test_loading_boolean():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading is False
    v.begin("q")
    assert v.loading is True
    v.finish(1, [1])
    assert v.loading is False


def test_rows_copied():
    v = View()
    src = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
    v.begin("q")
    v.finish(1, src)
    src[0][0] = 99
    assert v.rows == [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
    assert v.rows[0] is not src[0]


def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    v.notes = {1: "first", 2: "second"}
    v.begin("q1")
    v.begin("q2")
    assert v.notes == {1: "first", 2: "second"}
    v.finish(2, [1])
    assert v.notes == {1: "first", 2: "second"}


def test_multiple_requests():
    v = View()
    assert v.begin("a") == 1
    assert v.finish(1, [1]) is True
    assert v.begin("b") == 2
    assert v.finish(1, [2]) is False
    assert v.finish(2, [3]) is True
    assert v.rows == [3]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_monotonic_ids()
    test_only_latest_can_finish()
    test_finish_before_begin()
    test_begin_clears_error_and_loading()
    test_rows_kept_until_valid_finish()
    test_loading_boolean()
    test_rows_copied()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_multiple_requests()
    print("all tests passed")
